headline: At dx = +0.14 m, dy = +0.17 m, hole_pose() puts the hole 17.6 mm from where it is, about 10× the ±1.8 mm that Astra's policy searches around its estimate. The peg ends 17.1 mm off after 227 API calls and never pushes harder than 15 N, so the policy never notices: miss.
quote: Because camera-error bounds and contact stiffness are unspecified, small steps and an early force threshold reduce risk but cannot guarantee avoiding the 150 N abort threshold
